newsitem.title: USA: Jan Bell bidder gets 6.23 pct stake option.
newsitem.headline: Jan Bell bidder gets 6.23 pct stake option.

text.p: Ocean Reef Management Inc, which has proposed to acquire Jan Bell Marketing Inc at $4.00 a share, said Thursday it has acquired an option to buy a 6.23 percent stake in the company.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Ocean Reef said it acquired the option for 1,609,800 shares from a shareholders' group under an agreement signed on October 27.
The shareholders who granted the option are the Hay Foundation, Tropical Time Inc, Eliahu Ben Shmuel and E.P. Family Partners. The option is exercisable at $4.50 a share.
Ocean Reef, an Aventura, Fla.,-based firm, disclosed its friendly cash merger offer to Jan Bell on October 22.
